bs-kit.about: Tight, dry, close-miked kit for indie/jazz/trip-hop (Radiohead / The Smile / GoGo Penguin): a damped kick (short, no boom), a tight snare with less wire ring, crisp rimshot (rs) and sidestick (ss), close hats (h/hs/h1/h2/oh/hf), toms, rides; a touch of small room. Extends metal-kit's pieces.

bs-bass.about: Fingerstyle electric bass DI (P/J style): round, warm and fundamental-heavy, through a compressor. Fingertip plucks over the pickups with a plonk and a little fret growl when dug in — Motown to modern pop. Mono; scores default to octave 2. Techniques: `^dead` ghost note, `^h` hammer-on/legato, `^nh=2` harmonic, `expr.pm` thumb-muted (Jamerson-style), `bend=`.

bs-voice.about: Wordless pitch/vowel lead guide. Not lyrics, TTS, or a recovered original vocal.
